page.overview:
Who is Scorpion Spirit?

The was a demoness who dwelt near the Woman Kingdom.

The Scorpion Spirit appeared to be a dainty girl with spring onion-like fingers.

The Scorpion Spirit was once a normal scorpion which stung the Tathagata Buddha on the hand while he was meditating. He called for his Eighteen Arhats to catch it, but it escaped.

When Tang Sanzang rejected the marriage proposal of the queen of Woman Kingdom, the Scorpion Spirit suddenly sprang from the crowd and abducted him.
